exact_statement: For every integer multiplicity r in the public problem's domain, determine exactly n_0(r), the least integer N such that for every integer n>N there exists an antichain F subseteq 2^[n] whose set of occupied ranks {|A|:A in F} has cardinality exactly n-3 and for which every occupied rank contains at least r distinct members. A complete answer must prove both existence for every n>n_0(r) and nonexistence at the sharp boundary needed to establish minimality, with all exceptional small r handled.
source: https://www.erdosproblems.com/776; local primary reconstruction and He--Tang source artifacts under artifacts/erdos_campaign_20260720/
scope_notes: Write g(n,r) for the maximum number of occupied ranks of an antichain in 2^[n] having at least r members on every occupied rank. Then n_0(r) is the least N such that g(n,r)=n-3 for every n>N. Verifying one order n, one parity, or an unbounded subsequence does not determine n_0(r).

Local source artifacts record n_0(2)=3 and n_0(3)=8, the published-scale bounds 2r+2<=n_0(r)<=2r+2 log_2 r+O(log log r) for r>=4, and an internally audited but not publication-certified lower bound n_0(r)>=2r+4. These are dependencies and boundary checks, not a complete formula.

The primary route uses the shortened zero-seed Macaulay defect orbit D_(V-12)=0, D_(q-1)=V+KK_q(D_q). Its rank-8 entry condition D_8<binom(V-11,8) is equivalent, on the proved two-term chart, to W_6<binom(V-13,6). The inherited rank-8-to-rank-2 tail is already conditional-proof infrastructure and must not be recounted as new progress.

An all-V proof of the rank-8 entry, together with a complete replay of the inherited construction and parameter map, would yield a scoped upper-bound improvement of the n_0(r)<=2r+5 type. It may qualify as main_term_improved only after those dependencies and all integer ranges are audited; it is not original_problem_closed without a matching sharp lower obstruction and exact small-r reconciliation.
A refutation of the rank-8 entry freezes only this colex route. It does not refute the public antichain statement and does not determine n_0(r).

Finite V computation, a larger verified cutoff, another canonical carry normal form, an equivalent Galois complement, or a theorem assuming the rank-8 entry is non-success unless it supplies a genuinely new all-parameter closure mechanism.
No public search for an exact solution is permitted in this campaign. Old Erdős #776 artifacts are read-only and may be cited or replayed only at their recorded evidence strength.
